assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia.
The diagnosis code I47.1 is associated with the patient's condition.
The diagnosis code I48.0 is associated with the patient's condition.
The service is billed using CPT code 93247.
CPT 93247 represents long-term continuous ECG monitoring.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events and guide further management.
